halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Gqibezela uthumo lwephulo okanye umdlalo wabadlali abaninzi.
halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.guideDescription: Ukuvula impumelelo "Your Journey Begins" ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kufuneka ugqibezele ngokupheleleyo nawuphi na uthumo lwephulo okanye umdlalo wabadlali abaninzi.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Ukuvula impumelelo "Just Getting Started" ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kufuneka nje ubulale i-100 yeentshaba okanye abadlali kuyo nayiphi na iphulo lephulo okanye umdlalo wabadlali abaninzi.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Fumana umsayino wokubini ofihliweyo.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Ukuvula impumelelo "I’m Sorry, Dave" ku-Halo: Reach ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kufuneka ufumane iqanda elithile le-Easter elinika imbeko kuDavid Candland, umlawuli we-UI womdlalo. Nasi isikhokelo esineenkcukacha malunga nendlela yokusifumana:

1. Qala nayiphi na iphulo lephulo okanye imephu yabadlali abaninzi kwi-Halo: Reach.
2. Chola isixhobo **esingenalo** uphawu lomda wokwandisa. Imizekelo eqhelekileyo ibandakanya i-Assault Rifle okanye iPlasma Pistol.
3. Cofa iqhosha lokusondeza (ngokuqhelekileyo intonga ekunene kwiikhonsoli okanye iqhosha elichongiweyo kwiPC) ukuze "zoom in" ngesixhobo sakho esingafakwanga.
4. Jonga ngokusondeleyo kwi-**kona esezantsi ekhohlo** yesikrini sakho. Uya kuqaphela umtya wekhowudi yokubini evela ngokufutshane.
5. Le khowudi yokubini iguqulela kwigama elithi "Dave" kwi-ASCII yokumelwa kokubini.

Ngokulandela la manyathelo kunye nokujonga ikhowudi yokubini, uya kuvula "I’m Sorry, Dave" impumelelo.

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Ukuvula impumelelo "Balaho’s Most Wanted" kwi-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuya kufuneka ucime inani elidityanisiweyo le-100 Grunts kwimo ye-PVE, ebandakanya iPhulo, uMlilo, kunye Spartan Ops. Ngethamsanqa, le mpumelelo inokuvulwa ngokulula ngokudlala ngokuqhelekileyo.

halomcc-the-one-percent-088630ade1.guideDescription: Ukuvula "The One Percent" impumelelo kwi-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuya kufuneka ukhuphe inani elidityanisiweyo le-100 Elites kwimo ye-PVE, ebandakanya iPhulo, uMlilo, kunye Spartan Ops. Ngethamsanqa, le mpumelelo inokuvulwa ngokulula ngokudlala ngokuqhelekileyo.

halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.guideDescription: Ukuvula impumelelo "We're Just Getting Started" ku-Halo: Reach ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kufuneka udlale "Winter Contingency" mission ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni kubo nabuphi na ubunzima.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.description: Qokelela iphulo okanye iimbasa zoluhlu lokudlala ezingama-500.
halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Ukuvula "Just A Taste" impumelelo kwi-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuya kufuneka uqokelele iphulo le-500 okanye iimbasa zoluhlu lokudlala. Ezi mbasa zinokufunyanwa ngelixa udlala iphulo okanye uthatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni umdlalo. Ukwandisa inkqubela yakho, gxila ekubulaleni iintshaba ngokukhawuleza nangokufanelekileyo, ujonge ukubulala okuninzi kunye nokubulala iimbasa zespree. Ukudlala ngobunzima obulula kwiphulo kuyacetyiswa, njengoko kukuvumela ukuba uqokelele iimbasa ngaphandle komceli mngeni owongezelelweyo wobunzima obuphezulu.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Dlala umdlalo wabadlali abaninzi okanye wentsebenziswano ubuncinci kwiinyanga ezi-3 emva komdlalo wakho wokuqala.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Ukuvula "Stick With It...A Little Longer" impumelelo kwi-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kufuneka nje udlale umdlalo wabadlali abaninzi okanye we-co-op ubuncinane kwiinyanga ezi-3 emva kokuba udlale umdlalo wakho wokuqala.

Ngokungafaniyo nezinye izinto eziphunyeziweyo, le ayikwazi ukuvulwa ngokulawula umhla wenkqubo yakho, njengoko iqinisekiswa ngumncedisi.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Ukuvula impumelelo ye-"Pillar of Autumn" kwi-Halo: CE ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kufuneka udlale "Pillar of Autumn" mission ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni kubo nabuphi na ubunzima.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
"The Guardians Are Coming" impumelelo kwi-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) inokuvulwa ngokudibana nekamva elingaqhelekanga: ukubulawa ngendlela ephambanisa injini yomdlalo. Xa oku kusenzeka, umdlalo udla ngokubonisa umyalezo, "You were killed by The Guardians." Nantsi indlela ethe ngqo yokufumana le mpumelelo:

1. Kwimenyu ephambili ye-Halo MCC, khetha iphulo Halo 2.
2. Yiya kubuthunywa ukhethe.
3. Seta ukhakhayi lwescarab lusebenze.
4. Layisha i-mission yokuqala okanye nayiphi na enye i-mission oyikhethayo.
5. Dlala de ufumane isixhobo.
6. Dubula umgangatho.
7. Impumelelo ivuliwe!

Ukuba ulandela la manyathelo, uya kuba "The Guardians Are Coming" kwingqokelela yakho.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Yilwa ecaleni kweChips Dubbo kwaye umamele amazwi akhe obulumko.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Ukufumana "My Buddy Chips" impumelelo ku-Halo: Combat Evolved ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection, kufuneka udibane nomlinganiswa uChips Dubbo ngethuba lephulo Halo: Combat Evolved. Unokufunyanwa kwimishini eyahlukeneyo, kodwa abadlali abaninzi baye baphumelela kwimishini "The Pillar of Autumn."

Gcina oomatiloshe bakho bephila, ngakumbi ngexesha lecandelo apho imikhosi yoMnqophiso ikhwela inqanawa yakho, kwaye umamele incoko kaDubbo eyahlukileyo. Impumelelo kufuneka ivulwe emva kolu kudibana.

Kuyaphawuleka ukuba inkangeleko yeChips Dubbo inokuba yinto engacwangciswanga, kwaye ukuba unengxaki yokumfumana, zama ukudlala kwakhona i-mission kwaye uyithathe kancinci, uqinisekise ukuba uhlala nolwandle lwakho kwaye umamele yonke incoko yabo1.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Ukuvula impumelelo "I Need A Weapon" ku-Halo: Reach ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kufuneka udlale "Nightfall" mission ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekupheleni kubo nabuphi na ubunzima.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.description: Bulala umphuhlisi we-343 ekwenzeni umdlalo okanye umntu onale mpumelelo.
halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Ukuvula "Bite The Hand" kwi-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), umgca womdlalo wabadlali abaninzi kwaye ubulale abachasi ngexesha lemidlalo eqhelekileyo. Ithagethi inokuba ngumphuhlisi okanye nawuphi na umdlali osele enayo le mpumelelo, ke qhubeka udlala de ufumane ukubulawa okufanelekileyo. Ividiyo ibonisa inguqulelo yokuqala ye-Halo 4 yempumelelo, esebenzisa isiqhushumbisi somdlalo ofanayo.

halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.description: Halo: Reach: Jonga ilogo yenkampani yemigodi eneqhosha.

Yima apho unombono ocacileyo kwaye ujonge ngokuthe ngqo kuphawu lwenkampani ukuze uqalise impumelelo.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Yilwa ecaleni kweChips Dubbo yasentsomini kwaye umamele amazwi akhe.
halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.guideDescription: Ukuvula "THE Chips Dubbo?" kwi-Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-Outskirts kwaye uhlale kufutshane neMarines ngelixa usilwa kwiindibano zokuvula.
